name: milana-premium-mobile-app
description: Milana Premium customer mobile app for Android, iOS, and local web QA.

scripts.prepare:mobile: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js styles.css manifest.json www/ && rsync -a --exclude 'hero-fashion-video-source.mp4' --exclude 'hero-tennis.png' --exclude 'hero-garden.png' assets/ www/assets/
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run prepare:mobile && npx cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run prepare:mobile && npx cap sync
